title: Implement the test verb (run, gate, report)
description: Add cli/lib/test.js exporting test(cwd, args): resolve build/<slug>/, fail if build-report.json is absent, spawn `node --test` over the project's test glob in build/<slug>/, parse the summary lines for counts, and gate on build-report present + >=1 test + zero failures. On failure print the captured output and a `fail test:` line, exit 1, write nothing (including the zero-tests case -> 'no tests found'). On pass build and validate a test-report.json then write build/<slug>/test-report.json. Wire `case test` in cli/appbuilder.js out of the start/test/review/ship placeholder group, and add a Test section to the help text. Test-first: happy path (scaffold cli -> build -> test passes, report counts + schema valid) and gate reds (missing build-report; a failing test writes no report; zero tests writes no report).
acceptance_criteria: `appbuilder test <slug>` runs node --test in build/<slug>/ and exits non-zero on any test failure, missing build-report, or zero tests.
On success it writes a schema-valid build/<slug>/test-report.json with accurate counts and the exact command; on any failure it writes nothing.
test is routed as its own command and removed from the placeholder group; help text documents it.
